_comment: S5 Noise / Birdies — False-positive rate study (STUDY-SPEC §6).
name: Noise / birdies
description: Signal-free cycles. 30 trials per noise type (120 total slots). Drives: false-positive rate and between-appraiser agreement on false positives.
trials_note: Raised from 3 to 30 (12 -> 120 total slots) 2026-07-04, R&R-006 (GitHub #39). At the previous N=12, harness/analyse.py's MIN_N_FOR_FP_GATE (=49) meant this scenario could never clear the ratified R&R-004 95% Clopper-Pearson UB gate even at zero observed events -- every routine run reported the S5 metric as INFO, never a real PASS/FAIL. 120 matches the N already assumed by STUDY-SPEC.md Section 10's ratification text and worked examples (k=2 events -> UB 5.15% PASS; k=3 -> UB 6.33% FAIL), rather than introducing a new, undocumented sample size.
parts_note: R&R-009 (2026-08-23): the routine run_study.py battery restricts itself to parts 0,1 by default (qa/rr-study/run_study.py's _DEFAULT_BATTERY_PART_OVERRIDES) -- parts 2 (steady carrier @1500Hz) and 3 (multi-carrier birdies) detected exactly 1 false positive between them across every historical run in qa/rr-study/results/, versus 52+ from parts 0/1 (AWGN), including the only real regression this scenario has ever caught (2026-06-20 OSD FAIL). This file's own 'parts' list is unchanged and all four remain fully runnable, e.g. for a targeted recheck: `python run_study.py --scenarios S5 --parts 2,3`.
harness_note: No FT8 signal is synthesised. Each part renders a 15 s audio buffer containing only the specified interference. Any decode reported by either appraiser is a false positive.

parts.note: White (AWGN) noise — channel.py add_noise with no signal. CORRECTED 2026-09-03 (S5-LEVEL, qa/rr-study/2026-09-02-2002-architect-to-qa-spec-s5-level-normalisation-scope-and-repair.md): the declared level_dbfs was NOT what run_scenario.py actually delivered for pure AWGN -- its peak-normalise-to-0.9 step cancelled the amplitude term. Part 0 and part 1 rendered to the same actual RMS level (measured 0.37 dB apart, s5_level_scope.py ROW 0g) and were two replicates of one condition, not a level contrast. `level_dbfs` DELETED 2026-09-03 (PO ruling, Option 2, Amendment 1) -- S5 is declared single-level; the harness default (-20 dBFS pre-normalisation amplitude) now applies uniformly. Byte-identity of the delivered audio before/after this deletion asserted by ROW 0j (60/60 SHA256 match).

White (AWGN) noise. CORRECTED 2026-09-03 (S5-LEVEL) -- same correction as part 0's note: this was a replicate of part 0's delivered level, not a hotter one. `level_dbfs` DELETED 2026-09-03 (PO ruling, Option 2, Amendment 1) -- see part 0's note.

channel_note: Pink noise and swept carriers are deferred — channel.py currently implements AWGN only. Extend channel.py before running S5 parts 0–1 vs 2–3 if pink/swept variants are added.
